content.text: Tee atikiakea kecapi. Zaburuna Asaf to lagu.
Manga miana Yuda amatau Aulataʼala,
sarona amaoge i Israel.
Bhanuana i Yerusalem,
tee tampana mbooresana i Gunu Sion.
Iwe sumakomo Incia akatuki bhari-bharia manga ewangana potimbeana musuna,
bhari-bharia panana mokakila-kila, katangkesina, tee hancuna. Sela
Ingkoo ukocahea mpuu!
Alabhi umulia minaaka i manga gunu modhaangiana i zamani mangenge.
Hasilina potimbea padhamo atorampasi minaaka i manga mia mobarani.
Manga incia atokole saʼumurua;
inda dhaangia minaaka i tantarana sumai
momembalina moangkana limana uka.
E Aulataʼala isombana Yakub, roonamo kagorampangimu,
manga ajara tee mosawikia amalimpu.
Atotuu-totuu Ingkoo utomaeka mpuu!
Incema momembalina mopotaangina i aroamu wakutuuna upamuru?
Minaaka i sorogaa uparangoakea o kambotuna kahukumumu,
alamu uka amaeka tee inda tee uuʼuuna
wakutuuna Aulataʼala abhangu to apaʼadili
tee apasalaamati bhari-bharia mia motopisaki i alamu. Sela
Satotuuna o pamurumu tee maanusia imembaliakamu utopuji,
tee bhilaana pamurumu sumai upamembalia kabhokena tangamu.
Pojanjimo tee upomeamea o tolauna onimu sumai i KAWASANA OPU, Aulataʼalamu!
Taroakamo bhari-bharia modhaangiana i saripina
abhawa pasombaana to Incia molaengana imaeka.
Incia mopekamatena akalana manga mia mokokuasa,
tee manga raja i dunia amaeka i aroana.

footnotes.text: hasilina potimbea: I zamani mangenge, ande saangu lipu atalo lipu mosagaanana, lipu mokana sumai bearampasi manga giu mokoharagaa mboomo maanusia, bulawa, pakea, tee binata tee abhawea i lipuna.
